source.alternate_title: The Rand-McNally Bible Atlas: Historical and Descriptive; Illustrated
source.author: Jesse Lyman Hurlbut
source.rights_status: Project Gutenberg record states public domain in the USA.
source.recommended_citation: Jesse Lyman Hurlbut, Bible Atlas: A Manual of Biblical Geography and History, Project Gutenberg eBook 41140.

use_policy: Use as public-domain Bible geography visuals in Study Workspace, Passage Guide, and presentation slides.
Keep source and rights metadata with every public image record.
Do not mix these records with modern copyrighted atlas art or study Bible graphics.
